TAP_USE.label: Tap Use
TAP_USE.note: One press of the use key.

HOLD_USE.label: Hold Use
HOLD_USE.note: Held to charge, channel or sustain.

USE_ON_BLOCK.label: Use on Block
USE_ON_BLOCK.note: Needs a block face as its target.

USE_ON_ENTITY.label: Use on Entity
USE_ON_ENTITY.note: Needs a living target under the crosshair.

ATTACK.label: Attack
ATTACK.note: Bound to the attack key rather than use.

TOGGLE.label: Toggle
TOGGLE.note: Stays on until switched off. Persists.

CONFIGURE.label: Configure, then Use
CONFIGURE.note: Set it up first, then fire it.

PASSIVE.label: Passive
PASSIVE.note: Runs on its own while the stone is installed.

CONFIRM.label: Requires Confirmation
CONFIRM.note: Second press within five seconds, or it does not happen.

CONTEXTUAL.label: Contextual
CONTEXTUAL.note: Does different things depending on what you are aiming at.

stones.name: Space Stone
stones.summary: The stone that refuses to let a map matter. It starts with a 50-block Warp and a stored anchor, and ends holding eight dimension-aware waypoints, a private nine-stack cache, a corral that folds space around your animals, and a gravity field you can switch off.
stones.reads: Space is the quality-of-life stone. Most of its expanded catalog is logistics rather than combat — moving items, moving allies, moving one block of a build exactly one block sideways.

stones.name: Power Stone
stones.summary: Force with somewhere to go. The original four are a punch, a launch, a charged lance and World Sunder; the expansion turns that same energy on ore veins, stubborn blocks, redstone pulses, nearby machines and your own tools.
stones.reads: The only stone where the destructive and the useful are the same gesture at different scales — a Vein Burst and a World Sunder are the same idea, metered differently.

stones.name: Reality Stone
stones.domain: Block editing, terrain, illusion, phase, scale
stones.summary: The largest catalog in the gauntlet, and the one that behaves least like a weapon. Reality is a builder: palettes, block states, clone stamps, terrain sculpting, scaffolding that fades, an undo. Then it turns and offers a pocket dimension, phasing, intangible matter, and erasure.
stones.reads: Thirty abilities, and roughly two thirds of them are construction tools. The three Pocket abilities are deliberately one set — Banish, Entry and Collapse only read correctly together.

stones.name: Time Stone
stones.summary: The smallest catalog and the sharpest. Slow and Stop are the famous pair; the rest is tick control with a builder's bent — crop pulses, machine pause, copper aging, block rollback, and a construction snapshot the Infinity stone later builds from.
stones.reads: Time is the stone that talks to other stones. Its Construction Snapshot is what Builder's Snap consumes, and Timeline Erasure is the green counterpart to Reality's red one.

stones.name: Soul Stone
stones.lore: Binds life, death, memory, and spirit.
stones.summary: Capture something and it lives in your storage until you let it out. Around that sit the safety nets: a soulbound slot, a protected grave, a bank for experience, a fatal hit you get to survive once, and a resurrection token you have to pay for in advance.
stones.reads: The stone you notice most when you die. Half of Soul is insurance, and it is the only stone whose expansion is mostly about what happens after a mistake.

stones.name: Mind Stone
stones.lore: Sees thought and imposes absolute will.
stones.summary: Know All was the only Mind ability for a long time. Now it opens onto a full sensing suite — threat radar, ore sense, spawn-safety overlay, redstone inspector, farming overlay — plus orders you can give mobs and a scan that reads any target down to its effects.
stones.reads: Mind reads the world rather than changing it. Its overlays are private: the server sends them only to you, so nobody else sees your outlines.

stones.name: All Six
stones.domain: The Snap, erasure, the Universal Law forge
stones.summary: Not a stone you find — a state the gauntlet enters once all six gems are seated. It holds the Snap, a 224-block beam, Convergence, five bounded "snap" utilities that build, harvest, clear and repair, and the Universal Law forge.
stones.reads: The Infinity row does not appear in the R screen until all six bits are installed, and every Infinity ability re-checks that on the server before it fires.

systems.title: Installing the stones
systems.lede: A gauntlet is empty until you put gems in it.
systems.body: Stones are installed into one specific Infinity Gauntlet through the **R** screen, and the result is stored on that item stack as a six-bit mask. In survival the loose stone is consumed; in creative you only need to be carrying it. Shift-click removes a stone, hands it back, clears its quick-slot assignments and selects whatever is still installed. The six gem cuboids on the model are tinted by stable stone ID, so a half-built gauntlet visibly has holes in it, and the full-gauntlet glint only appears once all six are seated.

systems.title: Picking a power
systems.lede: Two keys, then the mouse does the rest.
systems.body: **R** opens the stone selector, **V** opens the ability list for whichever stone is active — both are Minefinity Core bindings, rebindable under `Minefinity Universe`, and the Gauntlet registers no duplicates. Stone tabs are filtered to what you have actually installed, and V refuses to open a missing stone's list. Right-clicking a power in any V list stars it without selecting it; starred powers collect into one cross-stone favourites view. Hotbar keys **1–6** double as quick slots while a gauntlet is held, and no extra Controls entries are added for them.

systems.title: The Universal Law forge
systems.lede: WHEN trigger → SELECT targets → IF conditions → DO stone actions.
systems.body: The Infinity catalog's largest feature is a visual rule builder with five saved slots. Laws are assembled from a server-approved palette — no Java, no commands, no arbitrary NBT — then validated, dry-run, compiled and executed by the server; the client is only an editor. Conditions have real `Then`, `Else If` and `Else` bodies, target sets compose through Add / Except / Filter, and a law-wide shield can exempt named players or anyone carrying a full gauntlet. Limits are 128 nodes, 64 actions, 12 nesting levels, 16 Else-If arms. You can edit on the in-game canvas or in a packaged browser studio the client hosts on loopback with a one-time token.

systems.title: Erasure has a colour
systems.lede: Three stones can delete something. You can tell which one did.
systems.body: When a target is erased, the server sends its exact final state to the client a moment before discarding it, and the client dissolves that captured model rather than playing a death animation. Snap and Absolute Erasure use brown dust, Time's Timeline Erasure uses green chronal energy, Reality's Existence Erasure uses red. Wide models dissolve sideways, tall ones from the top down. Nothing drops and nothing gets experience — but the kill is still credited to whoever caused it.

systems.title: Private sensing
systems.body: Mind's Threat Radar picks at most 128 loaded hostiles in a true 32-block radius and sends entity IDs and colours only to the one player who owns it. Minefinity Core turns those into a namespaced client layer routed through Minecraft's own silhouette pass — without setting the `Glowing` flag or touching scoreboard teams — so other players see nothing. Colour is priority, not decoration: purple for boss or elite, red for anything targeting you, orange for engaged, yellow for idle danger.

abilities.name: Warp
abilities.desc: Raytrace up to 50 blocks through your crosshair and relocate to the nearest safe landing point, preserving a short slow-fall grace period.
abilities.hint: Tap while looking at the destination.

abilities.name: Anchor Set
abilities.desc: Store your exact current position as the gauntlet's active spatial anchor for later portal travel.
abilities.hint: Tap at the position you want to remember.

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.desc: Place a temporary portal on the selected surface; entering it travels to the active spatial anchor.
abilities.hint: Use on a solid block to place the anchor portal.

abilities.name: Detailed Teleport
abilities.desc: Open a coordinate interface and create a portal to a validated X, Y, and Z destination.
abilities.hint: Tap Use, enter coordinates, then confirm the portal.

abilities.name: Block Telekinesis
abilities.desc: Lift a breakable targeted block into a suspended construct, then launch it as a damaging projectile.
abilities.hint: Use on a block to lift it; tap Use again to fire.

abilities.name: Vacuum Portal
abilities.desc: Configure and place a timed portal that pulls matching entities within the chosen radius toward its center.
abilities.hint: Tap Use, choose an entity filter and radius, then place.

abilities.name: Singularity
abilities.desc: Charge an owned gravity well in front of you; released singularities attract, merge, consume eligible matter, and decay over time.
abilities.hint: Hold to grow the aimed singularity; release to stabilize it.

abilities.name: Normalize Space/Time
abilities.desc: Collapse an owned singularity's mass and unwind nearby spatial or temporal distortion.
abilities.hint: Hold while aiming at an owned singularity or distortion.

abilities.name: Waypoint Atlas
abilities.desc: Store eight dimension-aware positions and teleport to the active one only when its chunk and a safe arrival space are loaded.
abilities.hint: Tap Use in air to cycle. Sneak + Use in air saves the next empty slot; Sneak + Use on a block overwrites the active slot; Use on a block teleports. A custom-named offhand item supplies the waypoint name.

abilities.name: Blink Chain
abilities.desc: Perform up to three six-block blinks at quarter-second intervals, stopping immediately before obstructed or unsafe space.
abilities.hint: Hold Use in air to blink along your current aim; release to stop the chain.

abilities.name: Mass Recall
abilities.desc: Immediately recall up to six allied players who are crouching within twenty-four blocks to separate safe spaces near you, costing four hunger.
abilities.hint: Have consenting allies crouch nearby, then tap Use in air.

abilities.name: Rescue Beacon
abilities.desc: Bind one crouching ally within thirty-two blocks, then recall that online, still-consenting ally across dimensions to a safe space near you.
abilities.hint: Sneak + Use while aiming at a crouching ally to bind; tap Use in air later to recall them.

abilities.name: Spatial Cache
abilities.desc: Keep up to nine full stacks in private persistent gauntlet storage; withdrawal returns the most recently occupied slot to inventory or drops it safely.
abilities.hint: Hold a stack in your offhand and Sneak + Use to deposit it; tap Use to withdraw one stack.

abilities.name: Item Vacuum
abilities.desc: Pull up to sixty-four unreserved or self-owned dropped stacks within twelve blocks into available inventory slots, leaving overflow in place.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to collect nearby drops once.

abilities.name: Cargo Portal
abilities.desc: Link a permitted, loaded source container and move its first fitting stack into another permitted loaded container in the same dimension, without chunk loading.
abilities.hint: Sneak + Use on the source container; Use on a destination container to transfer one stack.

abilities.name: Remote Hand
abilities.desc: Perform one permission-checked offhand interaction on a visible block face up to twenty-four blocks away.
abilities.hint: Hold the interaction item in your offhand, aim at a distant block, and tap Use.

abilities.name: Structure Shift
abilities.desc: Move a permission-safe volume of up to 343 blocks and seven per axis exactly one block along the final clicked face; inventories and other block entities are rejected, and the XP cost scales with non-air blocks.
abilities.hint: Sneak + Use sets corner A, Use sets corner B, then Use a block face to shift once in that face's direction.

abilities.name: Fall Gate
abilities.desc: Catch yourself or a falling ally after three blocks, move them to safe footing near your aimed exit, cancel fall damage, and launch them along your look direction.
abilities.hint: Use while falling, or aim at a falling allied player who is crouching to consent.

abilities.name: Spatial Anchor
abilities.desc: Create an eight-block-radius ward for thirty seconds that rejects a non-owner teleport when either endpoint lies inside, costing three hunger.
abilities.hint: Use on a permitted block to deploy; Sneak + Use on a block to dismiss your active anchor.

abilities.name: Boundary Ward
abilities.desc: Watch a twelve-block-radius sphere for sixty seconds and report counts whenever living entities enter or leave, costing two hunger.
abilities.hint: Use on a permitted block to center and arm the ward.

abilities.name: Mob Corral
abilities.desc: Maintain a ten-block-radius corral for forty-five seconds that gently pushes nearby animals back inside without damage, costing three hunger.
abilities.hint: Use on a permitted block to center or replace the corral.

abilities.name: Coordinate Probe
abilities.desc: Inspect an aimed point up to sixty-four blocks away for dimension, coordinates, block, light, fluid, and safe footing without loading chunks.
abilities.hint: Aim and tap Use, or Use on a block to probe the adjacent position.

abilities.name: Void Disposal
abilities.desc: Permanently erase the exact offhand stack only after a matching second activation within five seconds.
abilities.hint: Hold the stack in your offhand, tap Use to arm disposal, then tap again within five seconds.

abilities.name: Anti-Gravity
abilities.desc: Toggle a low-gravity drift field that arrests falls and allows look-directed ascent or controlled descent. Soul Creative Flight suppresses this movement without clearing its toggle.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to arm or disarm. Move while looking up or down to change altitude; sneak to descend.

abilities.name: Power Punch
abilities.desc: Charge a close-range strike that releases a dense kinetic impact and knocks surviving targets away.
abilities.hint: Hold to charge, aim at close range, then release.

abilities.name: Power Launch
abilities.desc: Propel yourself along the look direction with a controlled burst and a forceful landing shockwave.
abilities.hint: Tap while looking in the launch direction.

abilities.name: Power Beam
abilities.desc: Charge a 48-block piercing lance that damages and drives targets back, then detonates against terrain.
abilities.hint: Hold for at least seven ticks to charge and sustain the beam.

abilities.name: World Sunder
abilities.desc: Irreversibly erase without drops up to 20,000 editable loaded terrain or liquid cells across 150 blocks while obliterating caught entities; repeated casts create concurrent destruction waves.
abilities.hint: Use on the intended epicenter.

abilities.name: Vein Burst
abilities.desc: Mine up to thirty-two connected blocks of the same ore within eight blocks, collecting normal drops and spending matching offhand-tool durability plus scaled hunger.
abilities.hint: Aim at an ore with a suitable mining tool in your offhand and tap Use.

abilities.name: Quarry Palm
abilities.desc: Mine a permission-safe three-by-three plane perpendicular to the aimed face, skipping ores, data blocks, very hard blocks, and blocks unsuitable for the offhand tool.
abilities.hint: Aim at the plane's center with a suitable tool in your offhand and tap Use.

abilities.name: Siege Drill
abilities.desc: Focus the offhand tool on one permitted block until its hardness-scaled drill meter completes; losing aim, range, block identity, or tool cancels the drill.
abilities.hint: Hold on one block until the drill ring completes.

abilities.name: Power Forge
abilities.desc: Grant Haste II for twenty seconds to yourself and allied players currently within twelve blocks, costing four hunger.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to empower nearby allied miners once.

abilities.name: Tool Overcharge
abilities.desc: Grant yourself Haste III for fifteen seconds by consuming three durability from a damageable offhand tool and three hunger.
abilities.hint: Hold a damageable tool in your offhand and tap Use.

abilities.name: Kinetic Battery
abilities.desc: While armed, store 65% of damage received and 85% of damage dealt, up to 100% kinetic charge, for compatible Power abilities.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to arm or disarm charge collection.

abilities.name: Impact Guard
abilities.desc: While held, spend kinetic charge when struck to reduce incoming damage by 28-68% and sharply reduce knockback.
abilities.hint: Hold Use before a hit; release to lower the guard.

abilities.name: Redstone Injector
abilities.desc: Temporarily inject a data-free block's POWERED or POWER property, then restore its prior state if nobody changed it: strength 15 for one second, or strength 8 for five seconds while sneaking.
abilities.hint: Use on a supported block for the short pulse; Sneak + Use for the longer weaker pulse.

abilities.name: Machine Surge
abilities.desc: Give one loaded furnace, blast furnace, smoker, brewing stand, campfire, or soul campfire one extra server tick per tick for eight seconds, costing four hunger.
abilities.hint: Use on a compatible machine to surge it.

abilities.name: Power Beacon
abilities.desc: Create a ten-block-radius beacon for thirty seconds that repeatedly grants Haste I and Strength I to allied players inside, costing five hunger.
abilities.hint: Use on a permitted block to deploy or replace your beacon.

abilities.name: Demolition Pattern
abilities.desc: Break a fully permission-checked volume of up to 343 blocks and seven per axis, reject unsafe data-bearing blocks, record undo state, and charge scaled hunger.
abilities.hint: Sneak + Use sets corner A, Use sets corner B, then Use once more on a block to confirm.

abilities.name: Shockwave
abilities.desc: Push every non-spectator entity away from you within ten blocks without dealing damage, costing two hunger.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to discharge around yourself.

abilities.name: Momentum Strike
abilities.desc: Arm your next hit for five seconds; bonus damage and knockback scale with movement speed, fall distance, and up to 20% kinetic charge.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to arm, then sprint or descend and strike a living target before the charge expires.

abilities.name: Charge Transfer
abilities.desc: Move up to 25% kinetic charge per activation between the battery and the offhand item's persistent 100% charge reserve.
abilities.hint: Hold an item in your offhand and tap Use to charge it from the battery; Sneak + Use to drain it into the battery.

abilities.name: Emergency Discharge
abilities.desc: Consume at least 10% and all remaining kinetic charge to clear Slowness, Mining Fatigue, Weakness, Levitation, and Darkness, lift yourself, and push nearby entities; radius scales from six to fifteen blocks.
abilities.hint: Tap Use while restrained or surrounded.

abilities.name: Titan Strength
abilities.desc: Toggle immense strength, roughly three-and-a-half-times movement speed, and titan-scale jump height. Fully charged punches erupt in entity-only explosions, while meaningful landings suppress fall damage and cause scalable player-sourced explosions that never break blocks or harm the wielder.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to toggle. Sprint and jump with the active power; land after a high jump to detonate, or strike with an empty main hand or the gauntlet after the attack meter recharges.

abilities.name: Projectile Negation
abilities.desc: Continuously rewrite nearby eligible projectiles out of existence while the gauntlet is held active.
abilities.hint: Hold Use to maintain the negation field.

abilities.name: Atmosphere Shift
abilities.desc: Toggle the Reality Stone's world colour and atmosphere transformation.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to switch the atmosphere effect.

abilities.name: Heal
abilities.desc: Restore the aimed living target over time, or redirect the rewrite to yourself while sneaking.
abilities.hint: Hold while aiming at a target; sneak to heal yourself.

abilities.name: Block Shift
abilities.desc: Replace the selected breakable block with a random material from the configured transformation tag.
abilities.hint: Use directly on the block to rewrite.

abilities.name: Palette Shift
abilities.desc: Replace up to 128 connected copies of the selected block with an offhand block, preserve shared shape properties, and return the original material.
abilities.hint: Hold replacement blocks in your offhand, then Use on the connected source palette.

abilities.name: State Tuner
abilities.desc: Rotate a supported block state without changing its material; non-directional logs cycle axis and openable blocks toggle as a fallback.
abilities.hint: Use on a block to rotate clockwise; sneak while using to rotate counter-clockwise.

abilities.name: Builder's Wand
abilities.desc: Extend the selected face into a permission-checked five-by-five plane using matching blocks from your offhand.
abilities.hint: Hold blocks matching the selected surface in your offhand, then Use its outward face.

abilities.name: Clone Stamp
abilities.desc: Capture the safe non-container blocks in a five-by-five-by-five cube, then stamp that pattern three blocks beyond a selected face for hunger.
abilities.hint: Sneak + Use on the pattern center to copy; Use on another surface to stamp.

abilities.name: Material Exchange
abilities.desc: Swap up to 384 copies of two non-container block materials inside an eleven-block cube, preserving compatible state properties.
abilities.hint: Sneak + Use to sample the first material; Use on the second material to exchange the area.

abilities.name: Terrain Sculpt
abilities.desc: Apply a permission-checked nine-by-nine brush that raises, lowers, smooths, or flattens ordinary natural terrain and records an undo snapshot.
abilities.hint: Sneak + Use to cycle brush mode; Use on natural ground to sculpt for three hunger.

abilities.name: Reality Undo
abilities.desc: Restore up to 512 permission-safe blocks from your most recent supported Reality edit; block entities are never overwritten.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to consume and restore the latest Reality edit snapshot.

abilities.name: Temporary Scaffolding
abilities.desc: Create a permission-safe five-by-five light-blue glass platform for thirty seconds. Restoration survives restarts, waits for unloaded chunks, and preserves cells players changed.
abilities.hint: Aim at the desired platform height and tap Use.

abilities.name: Growth Rewrite
abilities.desc: Advance up to 128 nearby bonemeal-compatible plants once, or reset supported age properties while sneaking, for four experience points.
abilities.hint: Use near crops to advance them; sneak while using to rewind their age.

abilities.name: Weather Rewrite
abilities.desc: Rewrite the current dimension into a ninety-second storm, or clear its weather while sneaking, for twelve experience points.
abilities.hint: Tap Use for a timed storm; Sneak + Use to clear the sky.

abilities.name: Matter Repair
abilities.desc: Repair up to one quarter of a damaged offhand item's maximum durability at an experience cost scaled to the repair.
abilities.hint: Hold the damaged tool or armor in your offhand and tap Use.

abilities.name: Mob Polymorph
abilities.desc: Wrap an ordinary, unmounted non-boss mob in a related moving disguise for twenty seconds while retaining its original identity and AI.
abilities.hint: Aim at a valid mob within 24 blocks and tap Use.

abilities.name: Camouflage
abilities.desc: Blur your silhouette with twenty seconds of invisibility; the rewrite also slows movement slightly while active.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to camouflage for twenty seconds.

abilities.name: Illusion Projector
abilities.desc: Project a shader-lit, non-solid seven-by-seven construction grid at the aimed location for eight seconds without changing blocks.
abilities.hint: Aim at the guide center and tap Use.

abilities.name: Fluid Sculptor
abilities.desc: Place a small circular water or lava source pattern from an offhand bucket, or drain nearby source blocks when used on fluid or while sneaking.
abilities.hint: Use on fluid to drain; use an empty surface with a water/lava bucket to place; sneak forces drain mode.

abilities.name: Environmental Adaptation
abilities.desc: Grant a short context-sensitive defense such as water breathing, fire resistance, slow falling, or powder-snow footing.
abilities.hint: Tap Use; the current environment selects the adaptation.

abilities.name: Pocket Banish
abilities.desc: Send an aimed non-boss, non-mounted entity into your live pocket dimension while recording a safe return anchor.
abilities.hint: Aim at a non-player, non-boss, unmounted entity within 32 blocks and tap Use.

abilities.name: Pocket Entry
abilities.desc: Enter your personal pocket dimension and later return to the exact validated point from which you entered.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to enter; tap again inside the pocket to return.

abilities.name: Pocket Collapse
abilities.desc: Irreversibly destroy your pocket and everything still inside, permanently disabling future Pocket Entry and Pocket Banish; collapsing from within also kills you.
abilities.hint: Tap Use once for the warning, then again within five seconds to confirm.

abilities.name: Existence Erasure
abilities.desc: Launch a dense red Reality projectile that instantly removes the first non-player living entity it touches, leaving its frozen model to disintegrate into red energy without drops or a death animation.
abilities.hint: Aim and tap Use to launch the red erasure bolt for six experience points.

abilities.name: Reality Phase
abilities.desc: Hold yourself outside normal collision so you can fly through solid blocks. Jump rises, sneak descends, and releasing the gauntlet returns you to the nearest safe space.
abilities.hint: Hold Use to phase. Use normal movement controls; jump rises and sneak descends.

abilities.name: Intangible Matter
abilities.desc: Rewrite one ordinary clicked block into a visible but non-solid projection for fifteen seconds so every entity can pass through it, then restore it unless somebody filled the space.
abilities.hint: Use on a permitted non-container block to make it intangible for fifteen seconds.

abilities.name: Illusion Blocks
abilities.desc: Create a stack of sixty-four half-transparent projections that visually and physically mimic an ordinary offhand block. Players carrying a Reality Stone or a gauntlet containing one can pass through them; everyone else collides normally.
abilities.hint: Hold an ordinary non-container block in your offhand and tap Use. The sampled block is not consumed.

abilities.name: Reversed Illusion Blocks
abilities.desc: Create a stack of sixty-four half-transparent projections that visually mimic an ordinary offhand block but have no collision for any entity.
abilities.hint: Hold an ordinary non-container block in your offhand and tap Use. The sampled block is not consumed.

abilities.name: Illusion Purge
abilities.desc: Erase every loaded normal or reversed illusion block in a sixty-four-block radius without drops.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to clear all loaded illusion blocks within sixty-four blocks.

abilities.name: Size Shift
abilities.desc: Continuously rewrite your native size from one-eighth to eight times its original value. Growth increases reach, step height, speed, jump height, and safe falling distance; shrinking keeps normal traversal speed.
abilities.hint: Hold Use and scroll up to grow or down to shrink. Sneak + Use removes the Reality modifier and restores your original size.

abilities.name: Time Slow
abilities.desc: Toggle a temporal field that slows nearby living entities and moving objects while sparing its user.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to start or stop the slow field.

abilities.name: Time Stop
abilities.desc: Toggle a stronger field that suspends nearby entities and projectiles, then restores their preserved motion.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to stop time; tap again to resume it.

abilities.name: Personal Rewind
abilities.desc: Spend hunger to return to your position, rotation, health, air, fire state, and velocity from five seconds ago without restoring inventory.
abilities.hint: Sneak + Use after at least five seconds of timeline history.

abilities.name: Temporal Anchor
abilities.desc: Save your position, rotation, health, air, fire state, and velocity for fifteen seconds, then snap back before it expires.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to set the anchor; tap again within fifteen seconds to return.

abilities.name: Projectile Rack
abilities.desc: Freeze up to sixteen projectiles within twelve blocks in a visible orbit, preserving owners and motion for aimed release.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to rack nearby projectiles; aim and tap again to release them.

abilities.name: Growth Pulse
abilities.desc: Bonemeal or safely random-tick up to 128 growth targets in a bounded area around the selected block.
abilities.hint: Use on a block to center the growth pulse there; using in air centers it on you.

abilities.name: Machine Accelerator
abilities.desc: Run one selected furnace, brewing stand, campfire, hopper, or crafter at three times normal ticking for ten seconds.
abilities.hint: Use on a supported machine to accelerate it; the effect never loads chunks.

abilities.name: Machine Pause
abilities.desc: Freeze one supported furnace, brewing stand, campfire, hopper, or crafter while preserving its state, for at most five minutes.
abilities.hint: Use on a supported machine to pause it; use that machine again to resume early.

abilities.name: Day Dial
abilities.desc: Move world time smoothly over five seconds toward dawn, noon, dusk, or midnight, with XP cost based on distance.
abilities.hint: Sneak + Use to cycle the target phase; Use normally to start the selected shift.

abilities.name: Block Rollback
abilities.desc: Capture up to 512 blocks around a selected center, then restore later differences without restoring block-entity contents.
abilities.hint: First Use saves the area; Use again restores it. Sneak + Use replaces the saved snapshot.

abilities.name: Entity Rewind
abilities.desc: Return any loaded living entity, bosses included, to its location, rotation, and velocity from up to five seconds ago.
abilities.hint: Aim at a valid entity and tap Use.

abilities.name: Temporal Overclock
abilities.desc: Purge harmful effects and stale recovery state, clear current inventory-item recovery timers, then gain ninety seconds of extreme speed, haste, strength, regeneration, resistance, leaping, and night vision.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to force your body ninety seconds ahead of the world.

abilities.name: Delayed Trigger
abilities.desc: Schedule a temporary redstone block on an editable empty cell after a configurable one-to-fifteen-second delay.
abilities.hint: Sneak + Use in air to cycle the delay; Use on a block face to schedule a half-second pulse.

abilities.name: Copper Aging
abilities.desc: Advance up to 128 connected unwaxed copper blocks by one oxidation stage, or reverse them by one stage while sneaking.
abilities.hint: Use on connected copper to age it; Sneak + Use to de-age it.

abilities.name: Temporal Trail
abilities.desc: Display a fading shader trail sampled from your last ten seconds of recorded movement.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to show your recent trail; tap again to hide it.

abilities.name: Construction Snapshot
abilities.desc: Save up to 512 blocks around a selected build center and later highlight up to 96 additions, removals, or changed states.
abilities.hint: First block Use saves; later block Use compares. Sneak + Use replaces the saved snapshot.

abilities.name: Timeline Erasure
abilities.desc: Launch a dense green Time projectile that instantly removes the first non-player living entity it touches, leaving its frozen model to disintegrate into chronal energy without drops or a death animation.
abilities.hint: Aim and tap Use to launch the green erasure bolt for four experience points.

abilities.name: Soul Barrier
abilities.desc: Raise a personal soul-energy barrier that cancels incoming damage while the gauntlet remains held active.
abilities.hint: Hold Use to maintain the barrier; release to lower it.

abilities.name: Vampiric Beam
abilities.desc: Bind one visible soul within 32 blocks, pull it closer, deal periodic vampiric damage, and heal yourself.
abilities.hint: Hold on a living target after a short charge.

abilities.name: Soul Swap
abilities.desc: Exchange positions with the first visible living entity along your crosshair, preserving both rotations and safety.
abilities.hint: Aim at a living entity and tap Use.

abilities.name: Soul Capture
abilities.desc: Capture an eligible aimed entity into gauntlet soul storage, retaining its serialized identity for later release.
abilities.hint: Aim at an eligible target and hold until capture completes.

abilities.name: Soul Storage
abilities.desc: Open the authoritative stored-soul list to inspect, summon, or permanently release captured entities.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to open soul storage.

abilities.name: Soul Bank
abilities.desc: Deposit or withdraw up to 100 experience points at a time from a persistent gauntlet-bound reserve capped at 10,000 XP.
abilities.hint: Sneak + tap Use to deposit; tap Use to withdraw.

abilities.name: Soulbound Slot
abilities.desc: Bind your offhand, or the selected hotbar slot when the offhand is empty, so its stack survives death for 50 reserve XP.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to bind the held slot; tap again on that slot to unbind.

abilities.name: Death Recall
abilities.desc: Record your latest death dimension and coordinates, then show its distance, compass direction, and world marker.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to show or hide the latest death marker.

abilities.name: Gravekeeper
abilities.desc: When armed, collect your next death drops into a private grave for retrieval within five blocks; unretrieved stacks return after fifteen minutes.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to arm or disarm; tap near the recorded grave to retrieve it.

abilities.name: Spirit Lantern
abilities.desc: Make loaded undead within thirty-two blocks glow through terrain for sixty seconds and report whether a protected grave exists.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to light the spectral scan.

abilities.name: Spectral Scout
abilities.desc: Rapidly pilot a sixty-second spirit camera within ninety-six blocks while your exposed body remains stationary; damage ends the projection.
abilities.hint: Hold to pilot the scout; release or take damage to return.

abilities.name: Pacify
abilities.desc: Overwhelm ordinary hostiles within twenty blocks with peace, extreme weakness, and slowness for forty-five seconds; damage breaks their peace.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to release the pacifying wave.

abilities.name: Companion Bind
abilities.desc: Bind one owned tame animal and recall it only when loaded, alive, unmounted, and a safe arrival space exists.
abilities.hint: Use on your companion to bind; tap Use later to recall.

abilities.name: Sanctuary
abilities.desc: Create a sixty-second, sixteen-block greater ward that heavily damages and repels undead while granting allies regeneration and resistance.
abilities.hint: Use on the sanctuary center to deploy it.

abilities.name: Life Transfer
abilities.desc: Channel up to four health per pulse into an aimed ally without reducing yourself below one heart; transfer stops at their maximum health.
abilities.hint: Hold on an allied living target to transfer life.

abilities.name: Cleanse
abilities.desc: Spend 10 banked XP per harmful effect removed, cleansing shortest-duration effects first from yourself or an aimed ally.
abilities.hint: Tap to cleanse yourself; sneak while aiming at an ally to cleanse them.

abilities.name: Curse Vessel
abilities.desc: Remove one curse from offhand equipment by consuming a glass bottle and 40 Soul Bank XP.
abilities.hint: Hold cursed equipment in your offhand, carry a glass bottle, then tap Use.

abilities.name: Soul Mend
abilities.desc: Spend Soul Bank XP to repair up to twelve durability at a time on damaged offhand equipment, never beyond normal durability.
abilities.hint: Hold damaged equipment in your offhand and hold Use to mend it.

abilities.name: Spirit Beacon
abilities.desc: Broadcast your name, direction, dimension, and distance for sixty seconds to allied teammates who also enable their beacon.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to start or stop your mutually consenting team beacon.

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.desc: While armed, repeatedly deny fatal hits for 50 reserve XP each, restore sixty percent health, extinguish fire, and grant major resistance, regeneration, absorption, and invulnerability.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to arm or disarm; it remains armed and repeats while reserve XP lasts.

abilities.name: Possession
abilities.desc: Dominate a visible ordinary mob for forty-five seconds, greatly empowering and steering it while your aim commands attacks against nearby non-player enemies within an eighty-block soul tether.
abilities.hint: Aim within thirty-two blocks and hold Use to possess; release, take damage, or exceed the tether to exit.

abilities.name: Resurrection Token
abilities.desc: Spend 250 Soul Bank XP—no vanilla totem required—to arm a one-use fatal rebirth at full health that cleanses harm, restores food and air, and grants overwhelming protection.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to forge the token from reserve XP; tap again to disarm it.

abilities.name: Soul Census
abilities.desc: Count nearby players, passive creatures, hostiles, undead, bosses, and stored souls without revealing exact identities.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to scan the loaded sixteen-block radius.

abilities.name: Creative Flight
abilities.desc: Toggle full creative-style flight in survival, entering flight immediately and overriding Space Anti-Gravity while both abilities are armed.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to enable or disable; use normal creative-flight controls and double-tap Jump to toggle flight.

abilities.name: Know All
abilities.desc: Open the player tracker with names, dimension, coordinates, distance, health, armor, and sortable status.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to open the tracker.

abilities.name: Mind Annihilation
abilities.desc: Toggle persistent mind annihilation on any visible non-player mob, bosses included, without reducing its health. Releasing the effect restores AI only when the mob had functioning AI before this ability disabled it.
abilities.hint: Aim within thirty-two blocks and tap Use to annihilate; use it on the same mob again to release and conditionally restore its original AI state.

abilities.name: Tactical Scan
abilities.desc: Report one visible target's health, armor, effects, aggression, and tame-owner ID, then mark it for ten seconds.
abilities.hint: Aim at a living entity and tap Use to pin its scan readout.

abilities.name: Threat Radar
abilities.desc: Privately outline up to 128 loaded hostile mobs through terrain within thirty-two blocks. Yellow means idle danger, orange means engaged, red means targeting you, and purple means boss-level threat; no other player sees the outlines.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to enable or disable the silent client-side radar; it never occupies the action bar.

abilities.name: Ore Sense
abilities.desc: Count loaded ore-tagged blocks in a 17×17×17 volume and mark up to twenty-four nearest results for eight seconds.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to perform one local ore scan.

abilities.name: Spawn Safety Overlay
abilities.desc: Mark local dark cells with empty headroom, no fluid, and a sturdy floor that satisfy the overlay's bounded hostile-spawn warning rules.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to show or hide the local overlay.

abilities.name: Redstone Inspector
abilities.desc: Display direct and best-neighbor signal strength, powered state, and recent changes around selected redstone components.
abilities.hint: Use on a component to pin it; tap Use to clear pins.

abilities.name: Recipe Consultant
abilities.desc: Report loaded recipes that create or consume the offhand item, their recipe types, and up to five recipe IDs.
abilities.hint: Hold an item in your offhand and tap Use to print its recipe index.

abilities.name: Structure Locator
abilities.desc: Record one loaded, explicitly permitted landmark and later report its dimension, compass direction, distance, and marker.
abilities.hint: Use on a landmark to record it; tap Use later to locate it.

abilities.name: Route Planner
abilities.desc: Lay temporary navigation markers toward a permitted block, or your latest same-dimension death when no route is saved, while avoiding obvious headroom and floor hazards.
abilities.hint: Use on a block to set the destination; tap Use to create or show/hide its route.

abilities.name: Mob Command
abilities.desc: Bind an owned tame companion, toggle stay or follow, dismiss its link, or issue a permitted loaded-block move order.
abilities.hint: Aim and tap to bind or toggle; sneak + tap to dismiss; Use on a block to move.

abilities.name: Aggro Redirect
abilities.desc: Dominate ordinary hostiles within twenty-four blocks that can see and attack one visible non-player decoy, enforcing that target for thirty seconds.
abilities.hint: Aim at a non-player target within thirty-two blocks and tap Use.

abilities.name: Team Link
abilities.desc: Share your nearest threat or active route status with allied teammates who have independently enabled their own link.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to opt into or leave the mutually consenting team link.

abilities.name: Blueprint Analyzer
abilities.desc: Capture a 5×5×5 block-state snapshot and later count changed, missing, or differently oriented states at those saved coordinates.
abilities.hint: Use on a center or sneak + tap to capture; tap Use afterward to compare.

abilities.name: Container Auditor
abilities.desc: Summarize item counts in visible, loaded, permission-accessible containers without transferring items or exposing hidden inventories.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to scan permitted containers within twelve blocks.

abilities.name: Villager Advisor
abilities.desc: Report a visible villager's profession, level, offer count, stock and restock state, plus up to four exact trades.
abilities.hint: Aim at a villager and tap Use to print its trade analysis.

abilities.name: Farming Overlay
abilities.desc: Mark crops in a loaded local field and report maturity, low-light crops, and dry farmland.
abilities.hint: Tap Use while near farmland to show or hide the overlay.

abilities.name: Enchantment Planner
abilities.desc: List existing enchantments and up to twenty-four enchantments compatible with offhand equipment, including their maximum levels.
abilities.hint: Hold equipment in your offhand and tap Use to print the plan.

abilities.name: Memory Journal
abilities.desc: Keep up to forty-eight persistent coordinate entries from marked locations plus automatic death and landmark records; show the latest eight.
abilities.hint: Sneak + tap Use to add your location; tap Use to print recent entries.

abilities.name: Remote View
abilities.desc: Observe a loaded bound living entity for up to sixty seconds while your stationary body remains vulnerable; damage ends the view.
abilities.hint: Sneak + tap within forty-eight blocks to bind; aim or hold Use to view; release to return.

abilities.name: Mind Ward
abilities.desc: Purge blindness, nausea, and darkness, break nearby hostile focus, and reject ordinary hostile target acquisition for sixty seconds.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to raise the ward.

abilities.name: Confusion Pulse
abilities.desc: Cataclysmically disable ordinary hostiles within twenty blocks for thirty seconds, clearing targets and inflicting blindness, extreme weakness, slowness, nausea, recoil, and scrambled paths.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to pulse the loaded twenty-block radius; bosses and players are excluded.

abilities.name: Snap
abilities.desc: Erase half of up to 512 loaded non-player living entities within 128 blocks—including named mobs and bosses—without producing drops.
abilities.hint: Sneak + tap Use to execute the Snap instantly for thirty experience points; no charge or player-centered effect is created.

abilities.name: Absolute Erasure
abilities.desc: Instantly erase the visible non-player living entity under your crosshair from up to 128 blocks away, retaining its exact final model as it dissolves into Snap dust without drops or a death animation.
abilities.hint: Aim at the target and tap Use to erase it directly for twelve experience points; no projectile is created.

abilities.name: Infinity Beam
abilities.desc: Channel a movable six-stone beam in Normal mode, or cycle to FULL POWER for a 224-block terrain-annihilating beam with catastrophic damage.
abilities.hint: Sneak + tap Use to cycle Normal and FULL POWER. Hold Use without sneaking to fire and steer the selected mode.

abilities.name: Universal Law
abilities.desc: Open an authoritative five-slot law forge and program persistent event-driven rules from bounded Space, Power, Reality, Time, Soul, and Mind actions.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to open the manager; create, validate, dry-run, save, enable, disable, or manually unleash server-owned laws.

abilities.name: Convergence
abilities.desc: Cross up to 32 blocks, erase ordinary hostiles without drops, crush bosses for 512 damage, delete projectiles, fully heal and cleanse yourself, then assume a six-stone combat ascendance.
abilities.hint: Hold until all six stone arcs align, then release.

abilities.name: Builder's Snap
abilities.desc: Place up to 256 missing non-container blocks from your Time Construction Snapshot, consuming matching inventory materials.
abilities.hint: Save a Time Construction Snapshot first, then tap Use twice within five seconds to confirm.

abilities.name: Harvest Snap
abilities.desc: Harvest and replant up to 384 mature crops in a loaded twelve-block area, routing their drops into your inventory.
abilities.hint: Use on the field center, then tap Use again within five seconds to confirm.

abilities.name: Sanctuary Snap
abilities.desc: Displace ordinary hostile mobs from a loaded 24-block sanctuary to loaded surface positions outside it, sparing bosses and named mobs.
abilities.hint: Use at the sanctuary center, then tap Use again within five seconds to confirm.

abilities.name: Cleanup Snap
abilities.desc: Collect eligible unowned drops within 24 blocks and optionally erase only a fixed disposable-clutter allow-list.
abilities.hint: Sneak + Use toggles collect-only or clutter deletion; tap Use twice within five seconds to execute.

abilities.name: Undo Snap
abilities.desc: Rewrite the latest non-block-entity state snapshot recorded before Builder's Snap or World Repair; the restoration point remains reusable.
abilities.hint: Tap Use twice within five seconds to confirm the restore.

abilities.name: Emergency Recall
abilities.desc: Recall yourself and currently sneaking online allies to a validated loaded safe point, skipping mounted players and stale anchors.
abilities.hint: Sneak + Use on a block face to set the safe point; tap Use twice within five seconds while allies sneak to recall.

abilities.name: Law Console
abilities.desc: Open the server-authoritative Universal Law forge from a second Infinity slot.
abilities.hint: Tap Use to open the five-slot manager and edit, validate, clone, enable, or manually run a law.

abilities.name: World Repair
abilities.desc: Capture up to 512 nearby terrain cells, then restore changed terrain while preserving block entities and newer non-terrain conflicts.
abilities.hint: First Use saves a radius-seven snapshot; later tap Use twice within five seconds to repair. Sneak + Use resaves.
